messages.author: a4c5d7d1c977b688
messages.subject: MCMC algorithm for CJS model
parts:
Dear All,

I have been trying to write my own MCMC algorithm in R for an CJS model, but encountered some issues. My code is adapted from the Hooten and Hefley book: while they only considered a model with constant survival and capture probabilities, I want to make it work for a model with temporally varying survival and capture probabilities as functions of separate covariates. Also, I'm hoping to make the model work with data in the individual encounter history format (I did get the model work after converting the data into an m-array). My algorithm seems to provide biased estimates for a few parameters, while the bias seems to be related to shrinkage of survival probabilities to the mean (see attached figures). I wonder if this is just the property of the model, or I did anything wrong in the algorithm. In any case, it will be greatly appreciated if someone can either point me to a code source which I can learn from or look at my code (attached) and see if there is any mistake in it. Thank you.

PS: If you want to run my code, you could use the attached covariate data, which will allow you to get the same results as mine (since a seed is used).

Best regards,
Qing

messages.subject: Re: MCMC algorithm for CJS model
parts:
To report back, I just got the algorithm to work using binary sampler implemented in Nimble for z. I attached the code in case anyone is interested.

Best,
Qing
